The completed project helps create a major urban hub in Tseung Kwan O, strengthening the pedestrian systems by providing user-friendly pedestrian links to the adjoining MTR station, public transport interchange, adjoining developments and future district open space. Completed in early 2012, the project has a total GFA of approx.163,130sqm.
